points: Your site shows 14343 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry any number, so new buyers get no proof before the click. Open two ads with a training day quote, and print the review count on the creative.
Your site offers a first order discount, yet 0 of 29 ads mention any offer, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Put the first order discount in the opening line of three new ads.

25 of 29 copy ads open on “you’ve tried everything,” so every buyer sees the same promise. Build two new angles from your product, like training day focus and calm for founders, and test each against that opener.

One exact copy runs in 24 of 29 ads, so the same words reach the same audience again and again. Keep the body copy, but swap the opening line and the creative in each version so the feed shows something new.
